title: Usage monitoring and logging
description:
Just like the conversations are stored - we need to make sure that all endpoint interactions for a given user are stored, so that we could retrace any users steps by following these logs.
This should be all stored in a new database table "ActivityLog"

features.title: Create Activity Log Module, Interface, and Tokens
features.description: Create the basic structure for the new activity log module. This includes creating the `src/activity-log` directory, the `IActivityLog` interface in `src/activity-log/interfaces/activity-log.interface.ts`, the `ActivityLogModule` in `src/activity-log/activity-log.module.ts`, and the injection tokens in `src/activity-log/tokens.ts`.

features.title: Implement Activity Log Repository
features.description: Create the `IActivityLogsRepository` interface and the `DynamoDbActivityLogsRepository` implementation. This will handle the persistence of `ActivityLog` entities to DynamoDB. Also, add the new `ActivityLog` table name to `src/database/tables.ts`.

features.title: Implement Activity Log Service
features.description: Create the `ActivityLogService` in `src/activity-log/activity-log.service.ts`. This service will use the `IActivityLogsRepository` to create and store new activity log entries.

features.title: Implement Global Logging Interceptor
features.description: Create a new global interceptor `src/common/interceptors/logging.interceptor.ts`. This interceptor will capture request details (user ID, path, method, body) and response details (status code, body) and use the `ActivityLogService` to persist them.

features.title: Integrate Activity Log Module and Interceptor
features.description: Import and register the `ActivityLogModule` in `src/app.module.ts`. Apply the `LoggingInterceptor` globally in `src/main.ts` using `app.useGlobalInterceptors()`.

features.title: Update Database Seeding Script for ActivityLog Table
features.description: Update the `scripts/seed_database` script to include the creation of the new `ActivityLog` DynamoDB table. The table should have a composite primary key of `userId` (Partition Key) and `timestamp` (Sort Key).
